mission.short: Oakland's creative tech incubator empowering artists to become successful entrepreneurs through technology, mentorship, and community support.
mission.full: HiiiWAV is a visionary Black-led organization innovating at the intersection of art and technology to confront the systemic exclusion and exploitation that have long shaped the entertainment and media industries. In cultural hubs like Oakland—where rising costs, lack of access to capital, and now AI-driven disruption threaten the survival of independent creators—we exist to dismantle these barriers and build new pathways to ownership and sustainability.
mission.vision: An Oakland where creativity thrives and ownership is the norm.

description.short: HiiiWAV provides artists, activists, and creators with the tools, mentorship, and community they need to build successful tech-enabled ventures.
description.full: HiiiWAV is Oakland's creative tech incubator. We empower artists to become successful entrepreneurs through technology, mentorship, and community support. Our programs include Code Vibes (teaching creators to build AI-powered tools), Joint Ventures (fiscal sponsorship and partnership for artists), and community events like Oakland Tech Week and HiiiWAV FEST. We provide infrastructure for independent creators to build sustainable careers while maintaining ownership of their work.

programs.name: Code Vibes
programs.description: 8-week flagship program teaching creators, activists, and changemakers how to build AI-powered tools and software agents that serve their communities. No coding experience required. FREE for accepted applicants.

programs.name: Joint Ventures / HiiiFrequency
programs.description: Boutique, label-like partnerships with artists and organizations. Provides fiscal sponsorship, back-office support, and access to HiiiWAV's network of artists, founders, funders, and creative technologists.

programs.name: Oakland Tech Week
programs.description: City-wide celebration of Oakland's tech and creative communities featuring panels, workshops, demos, performances, and parties across venues throughout Oakland. HiiiWAV is a key partner and producer.

programs.name: HiiiWAV FEST
programs.description: Signature festival celebrating the intersection of music, art, technology, and community. Features live performances from Joint Venture artists, panels on creative technology, workshops, and community gatherings.
